messages:
emma: FYI customer AcmeHealth hitting wrong tool outputs when we fanout summarizer + fact_checker in parallel. Results look swapped sometimes, making assertions fail. Repro below, correlation id req-9f3a. @alex @priya can you take a look?

alex: Thanks. Can you paste the exact request payload + corr id + API version? Is this hosted or Dedicated?

emma: Correlation id req-9f3a, API v2. Hosted but routed to Dedicated pool (eu-west-1). Payload: ```json
{"input": "Article text...", "tools": [{"name": "summarizer", "args": {"max_tokens": 150}}, {"name": "fact_checker", "args": {"source": "web"}}], "options": {"parallel": true}, "request_id": "req-9f3a"}
```

priya: I pulled the logs for req-9f3a. Seeing intermittent schema validation: "expected object for 'tool_result' but got array" and then later we get two tool_result entries but tool_name mapping seems wrong. Snip from runtime: ```
ERROR aggregator.go:312 - schema validation failed: tool_result:expected object
INFO worker-12 - completed tool=summarizer call_id=req-9f3a:0 duration=120ms
INFO worker-9 - completed tool=fact_checker call_id=req-9f3a:0 duration=340ms
```

ops-bot: deploy-tracker: new runtime trace created trace_id=tr-47c2b for req-9f3a

ben: Looking at trace tr-47c2b, I see call_id reuse: both tool workers emitted call_id=req-9f3a:0. That explains the mapping collision — aggregator indexes by call_id and recent arrival overwrote previous result.

priya: Hypothesis: when options.parallel=true we fail to append per-tool index when generating call_id for multiplexed invocations. Quick fix: ensure call_id = request_id + ":" + tool_index (string) at caller side. I'll open a PR to enforce unique call ids upstream.

alex: Can you share a short repro I can run locally? Need to confirm deterministic repro before patch. Also what fraction of customer requests are impacted?

emma: Customer said ~3% of parallel tool invocations last 24h. They hit us on Dedicated, and account exec already escalated. Repro curl I used (intermittent): ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/invoke 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
 -d '{"input":"...","tools":[{"name":"summarizer","args":{}},{"name":"fact_checker","args":{}}],"options":{"parallel":true},"request_id":"req-9f3a"}'
```

priya: I reproduced locally by spamming 50 parallel requests with short delays. Fails ~4/50. Minimal repro script: ```python
# pseudo
for i in range(50):
  post('/v2/invoke', json={... request_id: f'repro-{i}', options: {parallel: True}})
```

ben: Found the exact buggy line in aggregator: we sort results by completion_time then use position index to remap to original tool list, instead of using original call_id->tool_name mapping. With collisions (same call_id) last write wins. Patch attached in my local branch: replace remap with lookup by call_id.

alex: OK assigning to priya to own the fix and release. Interim mitigation: set options.parallel=false for affected customer routes or pin to sequential call mode. @emma can you apply that config change and tell customer?

emma: Will patch their route to parallel:false and notify AE + customer in 10m. Adding workaround steps to the support ticket.

priya: I'll open PR with two parts: (1) ensure unique call_id per tool at callsite, (2) make aggregator resilient to duplicate call_ids (defensive). Plan to canary in eu-west on dedicated pool, then global.

ops-bot: incident-manager: Created INC-2026-778 assigned to eng-oncall.

alex: Thanks team. Priorities: PR + canary, customer mitigation complete, postmortem template. Leaving notes in the ticket.

emma: Mitigation done, customer updated, they're satisfied for now. Will attach logs and our findings to the support case.

priya: Owner: priya. Next steps: PR->canary->monitor. I'll post PR link here when ready. :white_check_mark:
